insights: The GW result reduces to three components: SDP relaxation (upper bound on MaxCut), hyperplane rounding (converts SDP solution to cut), and the arccos inequality (bounds rounding probability)
The core algebraic chain α_GW·MaxCut ≤ α_GW·SDP ≤ E[cut] is fully provable once SDP infrastructure is axiomatized
α_GW ≈ 0.878 is the minimum of (2/π)·θ/(1-cos θ) over θ ∈ (0,π], achieved at θ* satisfying θ*sin(θ*)+cos(θ*)-1=0
Conservative rational bound 878/1000 < true α_GW ensures all inequalities remain valid
Full formalization would require SDP theory and measure theory on spheres (not in Mathlib)
